payload.title: Close WP04 opaque-constructor admission gap on canonical ClayCode frontier
payload.work_clay: On the canonical post-#357 parser/analyzer/evaluator basis, make the bounded WP04 nominal checker independently reject direct construction of source-declared opaque records while preserving ordinary record construction and all existing nominal fail-closed controls.
payload.reason_clay: The analyzer already marks opaque construction UNRESOLVED, but the inherited bounded typechecker independently looked up module.records and admitted opaque constructors. Target falsifier run 31519056335 reproduced exactly this one-layer inconsistency: 13/14 checks passed and only opaque_record_constructor_rejected_by_wp04 failed.
payload.completion_clay: Complete when the exact minimal checker repair is target-green against current main, all 14 nominal/opaque controls pass, real frank.effects::decide_effect remains admitted with its exact reachable closure, plain record construction remains admitted, and no open comparison/host-signature semantics are invented.
payload.executor_policy: Bounded WP04 admission only; fail closed on open semantics; WP06 backends remain downstream and may not delegate Clay type authority to Python/C coercion.
invalidators: new evidence changing opaque authority contract
